newsitem.title: USA: Gillette stock falls after earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Gillette stock falls after earnings warning.

text.p: Gillette Co. stock fell sharply Friday after the maker of razors and other personal care products said Wall Street analysts should lower their earnings estimates for the year.
Gillette stock lost $3.81 to $86.25 after falling as low as $85.25 in morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company said its Braun unit, which makes coffee makers and other kitchen appliances, has been hurt by weakness in Japan and Germany, two of its key markets.

The company told analysts late Thursday that its 1997 earnings were likely to be at the low end of forecasts that ranged from $2.55 a share to $2.60 a share. In 1996, Boston-based Gillette earned $1.23 billion, or $1.71 a share, on sales of $9.7 billion.

Projected 18 percent earnings growth for 1997 to 1998 remained intact but 1998 earnings were likely to be closer to $3 a share than the $3.07 forecast in a consensus of analysts' estimates, the company said.
